service.description: The bookable resources, rooms then equipment, narrowed by type (room, equipment or all), text (name, site) and minCapacity (rooms that hold at least that many people; a room without a capacity is left out, equipment is not narrowed): each {resourceType, resourceId, key (type|id), name, typeLabel, site, description, capacity, approverNames, requiresApproval (the user is not an approver of one with approvers), policyText, url (ResourceDetail)}.

The bookings of resources (keys, type|id) from start to end (days, yyyy-MM-dd in the user's time zone): mantle.work.EventServices.get#FullCalendarData per resource (not cancelled; a denied booking left out), each {resourceKey, workEffortId, title (Busy for an event the user may not see), start and end (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm), allDay, bookingStatusId, statusLabel, statusColor, organizerName, mine, canCancel, url}. With includeUnavailable (Maintenance's ResourceCalendar, impl-maintenance P16) each resource's outages and planned blocks too (get#FullCalendarData's unavailableList), as items with blocked true, kind (actual or planned), the safe label as the title and no event. canCancel is when cancel#MyBooking succeeds (check#EventAccess's canBook): the organizer, also of an event an application keeps, or an editor of a calendar holding an event no application keeps; never a recurring booking from one meeting (impl-maintenance F357).

Books a resource (resourceType room or equipment, resourceId) from start to end (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm in the user's time zone): an event named purpose (the resource's name by default) in the user's default calendar with the user on it (mantle.work.EventServices.create#Event, sourceReferenceId BossBooking), then mantle.work.EventServices.book#Resource: booked at once or requested by the resource's policy; a clash refuses the booking and makes no event.

Cancels the user's booking of a resource (mantle.work.EventServices.cancel#ResourceBooking, which needs book access to the event: its organizer, also of an event an application keeps, or an editor of its calendar); an event made for the booking alone (sourceReferenceId BossBooking, no other attendees and no other bookings) is cancelled with it.

One bookable resource for ResourceDetail: what and where it is (get#Resources' entry), its booking policy, and the user's upcoming bookings of it (the next 90 days); found false when it is not a bookable resource.
